<body>
<span id="fc-probe" class="fc-probe" hidden aria-hidden="true"></span>
<div class="app" data-view="briefing">
  <header class="bar">
    <div class="heading">
      <div class="masthead-row">
        <h1>REPO ARCHAEOLOGY // INVESTIGATION BOARD</h1>
        <span class="repo-tag"><repo-name></span>
        <span class="f12-evidence-pill">EVIDENCE · NOT PROOF</span>
        <details class="f12-howto" id="field-guide-details">
          <summary>Field Guide · How to read this map ▸</summary>
          <div class="f12-howto-pop" role="region" aria-label="Repo Archaeology Field Guide">
            <div class="f12-fg-head">
              <span class="f12-fg-kicker">REPO ARCHAEOLOGY // FIELD GUIDE</span>
              <button type="button" id="field-guide-close" class="f12-fg-close" aria-label="Close Field Guide">Close ✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="f12-fg-section">
              <div class="f12-fg-sec-title">01 · START HERE</div>
              <p class="f12-fg-intro">Repo Archaeology examines Git history to identify files that repeatedly change together. Select a finding, inspect its directional numbers and supporting commits, and decide whether the companion file deserves coordinated review. Historical co-change is a signal to investigate, not proof that a change is required.</p>
              <p class="f12-fg-intro"><strong>Reading the blueprint plate:</strong> the selected pair sits on top. Files with a relationship to both of them sit in the middle, files related to only one sit on that file's side, and family files reached only through other files sit at the bottom. Position shows how a file connects to the pair, not how strong the relationship is: compare the percentages in the evidence panel for that. Dense plates hide some connections between context files and say how many; the Atlas shows all of them.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="f12-fg-section">
              <div class="f12-fg-sec-title">02 · GLOSSARY (12 TERMS)</div>
              <div class="f12-glossary-list">
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-ghost-wire"><summary>Ghost wire (ghost)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">A pair of files that repeatedly change in the same Git commits, where no direct or one-step-removed import link was detected in current code and the files could be checked.</p><p>Requires at least 3 shared commits and 40% directional co-change by default. A ghost wire is historical evidence to investigate, not automatic proof of a bug or runtime dependency. When both files in a ghost wire share a parallel sibling filename or reference the same rare environment variable, /api/... route, event name, or named export (used by at most 3 files), Repo Archaeology attaches a hiddenBridge clue to suggest why they might move together.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-directional-cochange"><summary>Directional co-change (A → B vs. B → A)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">Co-change is asymmetric: A → B measures how often commits touching A also touched B (shared / changes(A)), while B → A divides by changes(B).</p><p>If a small adapter file changed 10 times and 8 of those commits also updated a core router that changed 200 times, Adapter → Router is 80% (8 of 10), whereas Router → Adapter is 4% (8 of 200). Always check which file is the denominator.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-wilson-interval"><summary>95% Wilson confidence range (raw 95% CI)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">A sample-size-aware statistical interval computed from raw commit counts so small samples do not outrank well-supported findings.</p><p>A raw ratio of 2 of 2 (100%) has a wide interval (95% CI 34–100%) (lower bound 34%), whereas 9 of 10 (90%) has a tighter interval (95% CI 59–99%) (lower bound 59%). Repo Archaeology ranks findings and scales line widths by the conservative 95% Wilson lower bound (rounded outward so bounds never overstate certainty). Even when recency or origin weighting is enabled, the Wilson interval is always computed from unweighted raw commit counts.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-weighted-confidence"><summary>Weighted percentage (recency / origin weighting)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">When --half-life or --origin-weights is enabled, the headline percentage weights recent or human/agent commits more heavily than older or bot commits.</p><p>Because weighted percentages are no longer equal to the simple ratio shared / fromChanges, the report labels them explicitly (for example, &#34;68% weighted (60% raw)&#34;) and keeps the unweighted raw commit counts and raw 95% Wilson interval visible alongside.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-file-family"><summary>Finding family (3+ parallel files)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">A group of 3 or more sibling files sharing a filename stem across parallel directories (for example, src/adapter/*/serve-static.ts) with multiple qualifying pairwise links.</p><p>Instead of scattering N×(N−1)/2 separate cards across the report, Repo Archaeology groups parallel implementations into one family card showing how many commits touched 2+ members vs. all members together.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-unchecked-link"><summary>Unchecked / unknown relationship (unknown)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">Co-changing file pairs whose static import relationship could not be verified (non-JS/TS files, dynamic specifiers, or pairs beyond the classification cap).</p><p>&#34;Unchecked&#34; means static import status is unknown—not that an import link is absent. When top-link display caps omit lower-ranked unchecked pairs from the diagram, the report shows both the displayed count and the full repository total (for example, &#34;15 SHOWN OF 56&#34;).</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-heuristic-import"><summary>Heuristic import link (heuristic: true)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">An internal import edge marked with heuristic: true (while via stays relative, paths, workspace, exports, or imports) when the resolver maps build output directories (dist/, lib/, build/, out/) back to source files, or falls back to an in-repo package not declared in a workspace manifest.</p><p>Heuristic resolution prevents false-positive ghost wires in monorepos and unbuilt package layouts. The total count of heuristic edges is reported in meta.imports.heuristicEdges inside About this analysis.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-indirect-import"><summary>Indirect import (one step removed)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">No direct import link connects the two files, but one file imports a file that imports the other (one step removed).</p><p>Indirect imports explain why two files move together through an intermediate module (for example, a.ts → helper.ts → b.ts). Because the dependency path is visible in current code one step removed, indirect imports are separated from ghost wires.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-direct-test-links"><summary>Direct import (direct) &#38; Test link (test)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">Expected couplings where one file directly imports the other (or through a barrel file), or where a test file changes alongside the implementation it covers.</p><p>Direct and test relationships confirm that Git history aligns with static code structure. They provide structural context around ghost wires in the ego network and Atlas.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-counterexamples"><summary>Counterexample commits (Changed alone)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">Analyzed commits where one file in a pair changed without the other (fromChanges − shared, or toChanges − shared).</p><p>Inspecting counterexamples helps prevent confirmation bias: if file A changed alone 8 times for local formatting or unrelated helpers, and changed with file B 12 times when updating public options, you can tell which kind of edit you are making now.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-commit-origin"><summary>Commit origin shares (human, agent, bot)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">Breakdown of shared commits by author/trailer heuristics into human developers, AI coding agents, and automated bots (such as dependency updaters).</p><p>If a file pair only changes together in automated bot sweeps, it may be less actionable during manual code review than a pair repeatedly updated together by human engineers.</p></div></details>
              <details class="f12-glossary-item" name="f12-glossary" id="glossary-verdicts"><summary>Relationship verdicts (confirmed vs. expected / silenced)</summary><div class="f12-glossary-body"><p class="f12-glossary-sum">Team annotations stored in .repo-archaeology.verdicts.json that mark a known coupling as &#34;confirmed&#34; (highlight in reviews) or &#34;expected&#34; (silenced by default unless --show-silenced is passed).</p><p>Verdicts let teams record institutional knowledge directly in the repository so reviewed couplings are either surfaced with their documented reason or muted from default noise.</p></div></details>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="f12-fg-section">
              <div class="f12-fg-sec-title">03 · ABOUT THIS ANALYSIS · METHODOLOGY &#38; PROVENANCE</div>
              <p class="f12-fg-sub">Recorded settings, history window, and static import coverage for this standalone HTML report (local filesystem paths are omitted for safe sharing).</p>
              <dl class="f12-provenance-list">
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>Analyzed revision</dt><dd>Git history + current repository tree snapshot</dd></div>
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>History coverage</dt><dd>26 analyzed of 26 commits read (2024-01-01 to 2024-01-26) across 13 tracked files (0 renames followed)</dd></div>
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>Thresholds &#38; filters</dt><dd>Min shared commits: 2 · Min directional confidence: 30% · Max files per commit: 25 · Max commits: 5,000</dd></div>
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>Scoring &#38; weighting</dt><dd>Unweighted raw commit counts (ranked by 95% Wilson score lower bound)</dd></div>
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>Report edge budget</dt><dd>7 relationships drawn in report of 7 qualifying (4 of 4 unchecked links shown)</dd></div>
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>Import resolution</dt><dd>8 source files scanned (2 non-JS/TS, 0 unavailable) · 5 internal edges resolved (0 heuristic) · 2 unresolved specifiers · 0 dynamic loads</dd></div>
              <div class="f12-prov-row"><dt>Origins &#38; verdicts</dt><dd>Origins: 26 human, 0 agent, 0 bot · Verdicts: none configured (.repo-archaeology.verdicts.json)</dd></div>
              </dl>
              <div class="f12-prov-warnings">! Only 26 usable commits: results will be thin until the project has more history.</div>
              <div class="f12-fg-footer">
                <span>Generated by Repo Archaeology v<version> — An open-source developer tool for investigating hidden relationships in Git history. Historical signal, not proof.</span>
                <a href="https://github.com/lbrodie11/repo-archaeology" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">View project on GitHub ↗</a>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>
      </div>

    <div class="f12-help-title">GHOST WIRE · DEFINITION</div>
    <p><strong>A pair of files that repeatedly change in the same Git commits, where no direct or one-step-removed import link was detected in current code and the files could be checked.</strong> Requires at least 3 shared commits and 40% directional co-change by default. A ghost wire is historical evidence to investigate, not automatic proof of a bug or runtime dependency. When both files in a ghost wire share a parallel sibling filename or reference the same rare environment variable, /api/... route, event name, or named export (used by at most 3 files), Repo Archaeology attaches a hiddenBridge clue to suggest why they might move together.</p>

    <p><strong>A group of 3 or more sibling files sharing a filename stem across parallel directories (for example, src/adapter/*/serve-static.ts) with multiple qualifying pairwise links.</strong> Instead of scattering N×(N−1)/2 separate cards across the report, Repo Archaeology groups parallel implementations into one family card showing how many commits touched 2+ members vs. all members together.</p>
    <button type="button" class="f12-help-more-btn" data-glossary-target="glossary-file-family">Open in Field Guide ▸</button>

  <div id="help-unchecked" class="f12-help-popover" popover="auto" role="dialog" aria-label="What are Unchecked Links?">
    <div class="f12-help-title">UNCHECKED LINKS · DISPLAYED VS. TOTAL</div>
    <p><strong>Co-changing file pairs whose static import relationship could not be verified (non-JS/TS files, dynamic specifiers, or pairs beyond the classification cap).</strong> &#34;Unchecked&#34; means static import status is unknown—not that an import link is absent.     <button type="button" class="f12-help-more-btn" data-glossary-target="glossary-unchecked-link">Open in Field Guide ▸</button>
  </div>
  <div id="help-directional-pct" class="f12-help-popover" popover="auto" role="dialog" aria-label="What is Directional Co-Change Percentage?">
    <div class="f12-help-title">DIRECTIONAL CO-CHANGE % · ASYMMETRY</div>
    <p><strong>Co-change is asymmetric: A → B measures how often commits touching A also touched B (shared / changes(A)), while B → A divides by changes(B).</strong> If a small adapter file changed 10 times and 8 of those commits also updated a core router that changed 200 times, Adapter → Router is 80% (8 of 10), whereas Router → Adapter is 4% (8 of 200). Always check which file is the denominator.</p>
    <button type="button" class="f12-help-more-btn" data-glossary-target="glossary-directional-cochange">Open in Field Guide ▸</button>
  </div>
  <div id="help-confidence-range" class="f12-help-popover" popover="auto" role="dialog" aria-label="What is the 95% Wilson Confidence Range?">
    <div class="f12-help-title">95% WILSON CONFIDENCE RANGE</div>
    <p><strong>A sample-size-aware statistical interval computed from raw commit counts so small samples do not outrank well-supported findings.</strong> A raw ratio of 2 of 2 (100%) has a wide interval (95% CI 34–100%) (lower bound 34%), whereas 9 of 10 (90%) has a tighter interval (95% CI 59–99%) (lower bound 59%). Repo Archaeology ranks findings and scales line widths by the conservative 95% Wilson lower bound (rounded outward so bounds never overstate certainty). Even when recency or origin weighting is enabled, the Wilson interval is always computed from unweighted raw commit counts.</p>
    <button type="button" class="f12-help-more-btn" data-glossary-target="glossary-wilson-interval">Open in Field Guide ▸</button>

function advanceEm(cp) {
    if ((cp >= 0x0300 && cp <= 0x036f) ||
        (cp >= 0x1ab0 && cp <= 0x1aff) ||
        (cp >= 0x1dc0 && cp <= 0x1dff) ||
        (cp >= 0x20d0 && cp <= 0x20ff) ||
        (cp >= 0xfe00 && cp <= 0xfe0f) ||
        (cp >= 0xfe20 && cp <= 0xfe2f) ||
        cp === 0x200d) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (cp >= 0x1f000 && cp <= 0x1faff)
        return 1.45;
    if ((cp >= 0x1100 && cp <= 0x115f) ||
        (cp >= 0x2e80 && cp <= 0xa4cf) ||
        (cp >= 0xac00 && cp <= 0xd7a3) ||
        (cp >= 0xf900 && cp <= 0xfaff) ||
        (cp >= 0xfe30 && cp <= 0xfe4f) ||
        (cp >= 0xff00 && cp <= 0xff60) ||
        (cp >= 0xffe0 && cp <= 0xffe6) ||
        (cp >= 0x20000 && cp <= 0x3fffd)) {
        return 1.1;
    }
    return 0.55;
}
function codePointUnits(cp) {
    return Math.round(advanceEm(cp) / 0.55);
}
function measureLabelWidth(text, fontSize) {
    let em = 0;
    for (const ch of Array.from(text))
        em += advanceEm(ch.codePointAt(0));
    return Math.ceil(em * fontSize + 10);
}
function sanitizeDisplayText(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\u061c\u200b-\u200f\u2028-\u202e\u2060\u2066-\u2069\ufeff]/g, (ch) => {
        if (ch === '\n')
            return '\\n';
        if (ch === '\r')
            return '\\r';
        if (ch === '\t')
            return '\\t';
        const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
        return code <= 0xff ? '\\x' + ('00' + code.toString(16)).slice(-2) : '\\u' + ('0000' + code.toString(16)).slice(-4);
    });
}
function truncateLabel(text, maxUnits) {
    const cps = Array.from(text);
    const units = cps.map((c) => codePointUnits(c.codePointAt(0)));
    const total = units.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (total <= maxUnits)
        return text;
    const budget = Math.max(2, maxUnits - 1);
    const headBudget = Math.ceil(budget * 0.4);
    const tailBudget = budget - headBudget;
    let head = 0;
    let used = 0;
    while (head < cps.length && used + units[head] <= headBudget)
        used += units[head++];
    while (head > 0 && units[head] === 0)
        head--;
    let tail = cps.length;
    used = 0;
    while (tail > head && used + units[tail - 1] <= tailBudget)
        used += units[--tail];
    while (tail < cps.length && units[tail] === 0)
        tail++;
    return cps.slice(0, head).join('') + '\u2026' + cps.slice(tail).join('');
}
function disambiguateLabels(paths) {
    var _a, _b;
    const parts = paths.map((p) => p.split('/').filter(Boolean));
    const depth = paths.map(() => 1);
    const labelAt = (i) => {
        const segs = parts[i];
        const d = Math.min(depth[i], segs.length);
        return segs.slice(segs.length - d).join('/') || paths[i];
    };
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 8; pass++) {
        const counts = new Map();
        for (let i = 0; i < paths.length; i++)
            counts.set(labelAt(i), ((_a = counts.get(labelAt(i))) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0) + 1);
        let changed = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
            if (((_b = counts.get(labelAt(i))) !== null && _b !== void 0 ? _b : 0) > 1 && depth[i] < parts[i].length) {
                depth[i] += 1;
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        if (!changed)
            break;
    }
    return paths.map((_, i) => labelAt(i));
}
function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}
function compareEdgeStrength(a, b) {
    return ((b.rel === 'ghost' ? 1 : 0) - (a.rel === 'ghost' ? 1 : 0) ||
        b.prio - a.prio ||
        b.score - a.score ||
        b.low - a.low ||
        b.shared - a.shared ||
        a.id - b.id);
}
function round1(v) {
    return Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
}
function boxesOverlap(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}
function segmentsCross(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, dx, dy) {
    const o = (px, py, qx, qy, rx, ry) => (qx - px) * (ry - py) - (qy - py) * (rx - px);
    const d1 = o(cx, cy, dx, dy, ax, ay);
    const d2 = o(cx, cy, dx, dy, bx, by);
    const d3 = o(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy);
    const d4 = o(ax, ay, bx, by, dx, dy);
    return ((d1 > 0 && d2 < 0) || (d1 < 0 && d2 > 0)) && ((d3 > 0 && d4 < 0) || (d3 < 0 && d4 > 0));
}
function distToSegment(px, py, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    const dx = x2 - x1;
    const dy = y2 - y1;
    const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    const t = len2 < 1e-9 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - x1) * dx + (py - y1) * dy) / len2));
    return Math.hypot(px - (x1 + t * dx), py - (y1 + t * dy));
}
function segmentHitsBox(x1, y1, x2, y2, b) {
    if (Math.max(x1, x2) < b.x || Math.min(x1, x2) > b.x + b.w || Math.max(y1, y2) < b.y || Math.min(y1, y2) > b.y + b.h) {
        return false;
    }
    const inside = (x, y) => x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h;
    if (inside(x1, y1) || inside(x2, y2))
        return true;
    const r = b.x + b.w;
    const btm = b.y + b.h;
    return (segmentsCross(x1, y1, x2, y2, b.x, b.y, r, b.y) ||
        segmentsCross(x1, y1, x2, y2, r, b.y, r, btm) ||
        segmentsCross(x1, y1, x2, y2, b.x, btm, r, btm) ||
        segmentsCross(x1, y1, x2, y2, b.x, b.y, b.x, btm));
}
function wireControlPoint(x1, y1, x2, y2, bend) {
    const dx = x2 - x1;
    const dy = y2 - y1;
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const mx = (x1 + x2) / 2;
    const my = (y1 + y2) / 2;
    if (!(len > 1) || !bend || !Number.isFinite(bend))
        return { x: mx, y: my };
    return { x: mx - (dy / len) * bend * len, y: my + (dx / len) * bend * len };
}
function wirePolyline(x1, y1, x2, y2, bend) {
    if (!bend)
        return [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]];
    const c = wireControlPoint(x1, y1, x2, y2, bend);
    const pts = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) {
        const t = k / 10;
        const u = 1 - t;
        pts.push([u * u * x1 + 2 * u * t * c.x + t * t * x2, u * u * y1 + 2 * u * t * c.y + t * t * y2]);
    }
    return pts;
}
function boundsOf(poly) {
    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (const [x, y] of poly) {
        if (x < minX)
            minX = x;
        if (x > maxX)
            maxX = x;
        if (y < minY)
            minY = y;
        if (y > maxY)
            maxY = y;
    }
    return { minX, minY, maxX, maxY };
}
function polylineCrossings(a, b) {
    const ba = boundsOf(a);
    const bb = boundsOf(b);
    if (ba.maxX < bb.minX || bb.maxX < ba.minX || ba.maxY < bb.minY || bb.maxY < ba.minY)
        return 0;
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < a.length; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j + 1 < b.length; j++) {
            if (segmentsCross(a[i][0], a[i][1], a[i + 1][0], a[i + 1][1], b[j][0], b[j][1], b[j + 1][0], b[j + 1][1]))
                n++;
        }
    }
    return n;
}
function polylineNear(px, py, poly, limit) {
    const b = boundsOf(poly);
    if (px < b.minX - limit || px > b.maxX + limit || py < b.minY - limit || py > b.maxY + limit)
        return false;
    return polylineDistance(px, py, poly) < limit;
}
function polylineDistance(px, py, poly) {
    let best = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < poly.length; i++) {
        best = Math.min(best, distToSegment(px, py, poly[i][0], poly[i][1], poly[i + 1][0], poly[i + 1][1]));
    }
    return best;
}
function polylineHitsBox(poly, b) {
    const pb = boundsOf(poly);
    if (pb.maxX < b.x || pb.minX > b.x + b.w || pb.maxY < b.y || pb.minY > b.y + b.h)
        return false;
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < poly.length; i++) {
        if (segmentHitsBox(poly[i][0], poly[i][1], poly[i + 1][0], poly[i + 1][1], b))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}
function placeRow(targets, halfWidths, gap, lo, hi) {
    const n = targets.length;
    if (n === 0)
        return [];
    const offsets = [0];
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++)
        offsets.push(offsets[i - 1] + halfWidths[i - 1] + halfWidths[i] + gap);
    const q = targets.map((t, i) => t - offsets[i]);
    const blocks = [];
    for (const v of q) {
        blocks.push({ sum: v, count: 1 });
        while (blocks.length > 1) {
            const last = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
            const prev = blocks[blocks.length - 2];
            if (prev.sum / prev.count <= last.sum / last.count)
                break;
            prev.sum += last.sum;
            prev.count += last.count;
            blocks.pop();
        }
    }
    const y = [];
    for (const b of blocks)
        for (let k = 0; k < b.count; k++)
            y.push(b.sum / b.count);
    const yMin = lo + halfWidths[0];
    const yMax = hi - halfWidths[n - 1] - offsets[n - 1];
    return y.map((v, i) => Math.max(yMin, Math.min(Math.max(yMin, yMax), v)) + offsets[i]);
}
function chunk(list, k) {
    const out = [];
    let start = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < k; r++) {
        const size = Math.floor(list.length / k) + (r < list.length % k ? 1 : 0);
        out.push(list.slice(start, start + size));
        start += size;
    }
    return out;
}
function computePlateLayout(graph, focus, options = {}) {
    var _a, _b, _c, _d, _e, _f, _g, _h, _j, _k;
    const mode = options.mode === 'compact' ? 'compact' : 'desktop';
    const base = mode === 'compact' ? COMPACT : DESKTOP;
    const range = exports.PLATE_WIDTH[mode];
    const requested = typeof options.width === 'number' && Number.isFinite(options.width) ? Math.floor(options.width) : base.width;
    const W = Math.max(range.min, Math.min(range.max, requested));
    const cfg = W === base.width ? base : { ...base, width: W, focusSpan: Math.round((base.focusSpan * W) / base.width) };
    const nodeCount = Array.isArray(graph.nodes) ? graph.nodes.length : 0;
    const validNode = (i) => typeof i === 'number' && Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 0 && i < nodeCount;
    const leadId = typeof focus.leadEdge === 'number' && Number.isInteger(focus.leadEdge) ? focus.leadEdge : -1;
    const isShown = (rel, id) => id === leadId || !options.visible || Boolean(options.visible[rel]);
    const edges = [];
    const pairKey = (a, b) => Math.min(a, b) + ':' + Math.max(a, b);
    const leadRaw = leadId >= 0 ? (graph.edges || [])[leadId] : undefined;
    const leadKey = leadRaw && validNode(leadRaw.source) && validNode(leadRaw.target) ? pairKey(leadRaw.source, leadRaw.target) : null;
    const seenPairs = new Set(leadKey ? [leadKey] : []);
    (graph.edges || []).forEach((e, id) => {
        var _a, _b;
        if (!e || !validNode(e.source) || !validNode(e.target) || e.source === e.target)
            return;
        if (!isShown(e.relationship, id))
            return;
        const key = pairKey(e.source, e.target);
        if (id !== leadId && seenPairs.has(key))
            return;
        seenPairs.add(key);
        const low = Math.max(finite((_a = e.interval) === null || _a === void 0 ? void 0 : _a.low), finite((_b = e.reverseInterval) === null || _b === void 0 ? void 0 : _b.low));
        edges.push({
            id,
            s: e.source,
            t: e.target,
            rel: e.relationship,
            low: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, low)),
            score: finite(e.score),
            prio: finite(e.overviewPriority),
            shared: finite(e.shared),
        });
    });
    const edgeById = new Map();
    const adjacency = new Map();
    for (const e of edges) {
        edgeById.set(e.id, e);
        for (const v of [e.s, e.t]) {
            const list = adjacency.get(v);
            if (list)
                list.push(e);
            else
                adjacency.set(v, [e]);
        }
    }
    const other = (e, v) => (e.s === v ? e.t : e.s);
    const lead = (_a = edgeById.get(leadId)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : null;
    const A = lead ? lead.s : -1;
    const B = lead ? lead.t : -1;
    const seeds = Array.from(new Set((focus.seeds || []).filter(validNode))).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    if (lead) {
        for (const v of [A, B])
            if (seeds.indexOf(v) < 0)
                seeds.push(v);
    }
    const featured = new Set((focus.featuredEdges || []).filter((id) => edgeById.has(id)));
    if (lead)
        featured.add(lead.id);
    const compSeen = new Set(seeds);
    const queue = seeds.slice();
    for (let q = 0; q < queue.length; q++) {
        for (const e of (_b = adjacency.get(queue[q])) !== null && _b !== void 0 ? _b : []) {
            const v = other(e, queue[q]);
            if (!compSeen.has(v)) {
                compSeen.add(v);
                queue.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    const bestEdgeBetween = (v, targets) => {
        var _a;
        let best = null;
        for (const e of (_a = adjacency.get(v)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : []) {
            if (targets.has(other(e, v)) && (!best || compareEdgeStrength(e, best) < 0))
                best = e;
        }
        return best;
    };
    const byStrength = (a, b) => {
        if (a.edge && b.edge)
            return compareEdgeStrength(a.edge, b.edge) || a.id - b.id;
        if (a.edge)
            return -1;
        if (b.edge)
            return 1;
        return a.id - b.id;
    };
    const pathOf = (v) => sanitizeDisplayText(graph.nodes[v].path);
    const focusSet = new Set(lead ? [A, B] : []);
    const ego = lead ? [A, B] : [];
    const seedRank = seeds
        .filter((v) => !focusSet.has(v))
        .map((id) => ({ id, edge: bestEdgeBetween(id, focusSet.size ? focusSet : new Set(seeds)) }))
        .sort(byStrength);
    for (const s of seedRank)
        if (ego.length < exports.MAX_EGO_NODES)
            ego.push(s.id);
    if (ego.length < exports.MAX_EGO_NODES) {
        const egoSet = new Set(ego);
        const candidates = new Map();
        for (const v of ego) {
            for (const e of (_c = adjacency.get(v)) !== null && _c !== void 0 ? _c : []) {
                const u = other(e, v);
                if (egoSet.has(u))
                    continue;
                const prev = candidates.get(u);
                if (!prev || compareEdgeStrength(e, prev) < 0)
                    candidates.set(u, e);
            }
        }
        const ranked = Array.from(candidates.entries())
            .map(([id, edge]) => ({ id, edge }))
            .sort(byStrength);
        for (const c of ranked)
            if (ego.length < exports.MAX_EGO_NODES)
                ego.push(c.id);
    }
    const egoSet = new Set(ego);
    const neighbours = (v) => { var _a; return ((_a = adjacency.get(v)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : []).map((e) => other(e, v)).filter((u) => egoSet.has(u)); };
    const groupOf = (v) => {
        if (focusSet.has(v))
            return 'focus';
        if (!lead)
            return 'other';
        const ns = neighbours(v);
        const hasA = ns.indexOf(A) >= 0;
        const hasB = ns.indexOf(B) >= 0;
        return hasA && hasB ? 'shared' : hasA ? 'a-only' : hasB ? 'b-only' : 'other';
    };
    const groupOrder = { focus: 0, shared: 1, 'a-only': 2, 'b-only': 2, other: 3 };
    const strengthToPair = (v) => { var _a; return (_a = bestEdgeBetween(v, focusSet.size ? focusSet : egoSet)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : bestEdgeBetween(v, egoSet); };
    const contextRanked = ego
        .filter((v) => !focusSet.has(v))
        .map((id) => ({ id, group: groupOf(id), edge: strengthToPair(id) }))
        .sort((a, b) => groupOrder[a.group] - groupOrder[b.group] || byStrength(a, b));
    const disconnected = lead ? contextRanked.filter((c) => neighbours(c.id).length === 0).map((c) => c.id) : [];
    const connectedContext = contextRanked.filter((c) => disconnected.indexOf(c.id) < 0);
    const compactDrawable = lead
        ? connectedContext.filter((c) => c.group !== 'other').slice(0, exports.COMPACT_CONTEXT_NODES)
        : connectedContext.slice(0, exports.COMPACT_CONTEXT_NODES + 2);
    const drawnContext = mode === 'compact' ? compactDrawable : connectedContext;
    const overflowContext = mode === 'compact' ? connectedContext.filter((c) => compactDrawable.indexOf(c) < 0) : [];
    const drawnIds = ego.filter((v) => focusSet.has(v)).concat(drawnContext.map((c) => c.id));
    const drawnSet = new Set(drawnIds);
    const visibleIds = drawnIds.concat(overflowContext.map((c) => c.id));
    const fullLabels = disambiguateLabels(visibleIds.map(pathOf));
    const labelById = new Map();
    visibleIds.forEach((id, i) => labelById.set(id, fullLabels[i]));
    const raw = edges.filter((e) => drawnSet.has(e.s) && drawnSet.has(e.t)).sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
    const showAll = !lead || raw.length <= drawnIds.length + 3;
    const kept = showAll ? raw.slice() : raw.filter((e) => focusSet.has(e.s) || focusSet.has(e.t));
    if (!showAll) {
        const degree = new Map();
        for (const e of kept)
            for (const v of [e.s, e.t])
                degree.set(v, ((_d = degree.get(v)) !== null && _d !== void 0 ? _d : 0) + 1);
        for (const v of drawnIds) {
            if (degree.get(v))
                continue;
            const rescue = raw.filter((e) => e.s === v || e.t === v).sort(compareEdgeStrength)[0];
            if (rescue && kept.indexOf(rescue) < 0) {
                kept.push(rescue);
                for (const u of [rescue.s, rescue.t])
                    degree.set(u, ((_e = degree.get(u)) !== null && _e !== void 0 ? _e : 0) + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    const optionalWires = showAll ? [] : raw.filter((e) => kept.indexOf(e) < 0).sort(compareEdgeStrength);
    const placementNeighbours = new Map();
    for (const e of kept) {
        for (const v of [e.s, e.t]) {
            const list = placementNeighbours.get(v);
            if (list)
                list.push(other(e, v));
            else
                placementNeighbours.set(v, [other(e, v)]);
        }
    }
    const focusLabelMax = Math.floor((W / 2 - cfg.pad - 12) / (cfg.focusFont * 0.55)) - 2;
    const rowCap = W - 2 * cfg.pad;
    const contextLabelMax = Math.min(cfg.maxLabelUnits, Math.floor((rowCap - cfg.slotGap - 10) / (cfg.labelFont * 0.55)));
    const radiusOf = (v) => {
        const base = Math.max(5.5, Math.min(11, 4.2 + Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, finite(graph.nodes[v].changes))) * 0.85));
        return round1(focusSet.has(v) ? Math.max(7.5, base) : base);
    };
    const pnodes = new Map();
    const rankById = new Map();
    contextRanked.forEach((c, i) => rankById.set(c.id, i));
    for (const id of drawnIds) {
        const isFocus = focusSet.has(id);
        const label = truncateLabel((_f = labelById.get(id)) !== null && _f !== void 0 ? _f : pathOf(id), isFocus ? Math.min(cfg.maxLabelUnits, focusLabelMax) : contextLabelMax);
        const labelW = measureLabelWidth(label, isFocus ? cfg.focusFont : cfg.labelFont);
        const r = radiusOf(id);
        const group = groupOf(id);
        pnodes.set(id, {
            id,
            path: pathOf(id),
            dir: sanitizeDisplayText(graph.nodes[id].dir),
            changes: finite(graph.nodes[id].changes),
            group,
            side: group === 'a-only' ? 0 : group === 'b-only' ? 2 : 1,
            rank: (_g = rankById.get(id)) !== null && _g !== void 0 ? _g : -1,
            r,
            label,
            labelW,
            slotHalf: Math.max(labelW, 2 * r) / 2,
        });
    }
    const byGroup = (g) => drawnContext.filter((c) => c.group === g).map((c) => pnodes.get(c.id));
    const fits = (row) => row.reduce((sum, p) => sum + 2 * p.slotHalf, 0) + Math.max(0, row.length - 1) * cfg.slotGap <= rowCap + 1e-6;
    const packTier = (sides) => {
        const live = sides.filter((s) => s.length > 0);
        if (live.length === 0)
            return [];
        const most = Math.max(...live.map((s) => s.length));
        for (let k = 1; k <= most; k++) {
            const rows = [];
            for (let r = 0; r < k; r++)
                rows.push([].concat(...live.map((s) => chunk(s, k)[r])));
            if (rows.every(fits))
                return rows.filter((row) => row.length > 0);
        }
        return live.reduce((acc, s) => acc.concat(s.map((p) => [p])), []);
    };
    const rows = [
        ...packTier([byGroup('shared')]),
        ...packTier([byGroup('a-only'), byGroup('b-only')]),
        ...packTier([byGroup('other')]),
    ];
    const previousX = new Map();
    for (const p of (_h = options.previous) !== null && _h !== void 0 ? _h : []) {
        if (p && validNode(p.nodeIndex) && Number.isFinite(p.x))
            previousX.set(p.nodeIndex, p.x);
    }
    const mid = W / 2;
    const pos = new Map();
    if (lead) {
        const pa = pnodes.get(A);
        const pb = pnodes.get(B);
        const half = Math.max(cfg.focusSpan / 2, Math.max(pa.labelW, pb.labelW) / 2 + 14);
        const ax = Math.max(cfg.pad + pa.labelW / 2, Math.min(mid - 14 - pa.labelW / 2, mid - half));
        const bx = Math.min(W - cfg.pad - pb.labelW / 2, Math.max(mid + 14 + pb.labelW / 2, mid + half));
        pos.set(A, { x: ax, y: cfg.focusY });
        pos.set(B, { x: bx, y: cfg.focusY });
    }
    const firstRowY = lead ? cfg.focusY + cfg.firstRowGap : cfg.pad + exports.LABEL_HEIGHT;
    const rowY = (r) => firstRowY + r * cfg.rowGap;
    const targetX = (p, g) => {
        var _a, _b;
        const placed = ((_a = placementNeighbours.get(p.id)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : []).filter((u) => g.has(u));
        if (placed.length > 0)
            return placed.reduce((sum, u) => sum + g.get(u).x, 0) / placed.length;
        return (_b = previousX.get(p.id)) !== null && _b !== void 0 ? _b : mid;
    };
    const placeOrders = (orders, shifts = []) => {
        const g = new Map(pos);
        orders.forEach((row, r) => {
            const targets = row.map((p) => { var _a; return targetX(p, g) + ((_a = shifts[r]) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0); });
            const xs = placeRow(targets, row.map((p) => p.slotHalf), cfg.slotGap, cfg.pad, W - cfg.pad);
            row.forEach((p, i) => g.set(p.id, { x: xs[i], y: rowY(r) }));
        });
        return g;
    };
    const geometry = (orders, shifts = []) => {
        const g = placeOrders(orders, shifts);
        const metrics = measure(g);
        let movement = 0;
        for (const [id, x] of previousX)
            if (g.has(id) && !focusSet.has(id))
                movement += Math.abs(g.get(id).x - x) / W;
        let length = 0;
        for (const e of kept)
            length += Math.hypot(g.get(e.s).x - g.get(e.t).x, g.get(e.s).y - g.get(e.t).y) / W;
        const score = OBJECTIVE.labelOverlap * metrics.labelOverlaps +
            OBJECTIVE.labelNodeOverlap * metrics.labelNodeOverlaps +
            OBJECTIVE.wireThroughDot * metrics.wiresThroughDots +
            OBJECTIVE.weightedCrossing * metrics.weightedCrossings +
            OBJECTIVE.wireThroughLabel * metrics.wiresThroughLabels +
            OBJECTIVE.wireLength * length +
            OBJECTIVE.movement * movement;
        return { pos: g, score, metrics };
    };
    const labelBoxOf = (p, at) => focusSet.has(p.id)
        ? { x: at.x - p.labelW / 2, y: at.y - p.r - 5 - exports.LABEL_HEIGHT, w: p.labelW, h: exports.LABEL_HEIGHT }
        : { x: at.x - p.labelW / 2, y: at.y + p.r + 5, w: p.labelW, h: exports.LABEL_HEIGHT };
    function measure(g, bends) {
        const list = drawnIds.map((id) => ({ p: pnodes.get(id), at: g.get(id) }));
        const boxes = list.map(({ p, at }) => labelBoxOf(p, at));
        let labelOverlaps = 0;
        let labelNodeOverlaps = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            for (let j = i + 1; j < list.length; j++)
                if (boxesOverlap(boxes[i], boxes[j]))
                    labelOverlaps++;
            for (let j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
                if (i === j)
                    continue;
                const c = list[j];
                const b = boxes[i];
                const nx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(c.at.x, b.x + b.w));
                const ny = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(c.at.y, b.y + b.h));
                if (Math.hypot(c.at.x - nx, c.at.y - ny) < c.p.r)
                    labelNodeOverlaps++;
            }
        }
        const weight = (e) => (e === lead ? 3 : focusSet.has(e.s) || focusSet.has(e.t) ? 1.5 : 1);
        const polys = kept.map((e) => {
            var _a;
            const p1 = g.get(e.s), p2 = g.get(e.t);
            return wirePolyline(p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y, (_a = bends === null || bends === void 0 ? void 0 : bends.get(e.id)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0);
        });
        let crossings = 0;
        let weightedCrossings = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < kept.length; i++) {
            for (let j = i + 1; j < kept.length; j++) {
                const e = kept[i];
                const f = kept[j];
                if (e.s === f.s || e.s === f.t || e.t === f.s || e.t === f.t)
                    continue;
                const n = polylineCrossings(polys[i], polys[j]);
                crossings += n;
                weightedCrossings += n * weight(e) * weight(f);
            }
        }
        let wiresThroughDots = 0;
        let wiresThroughLabels = 0;
        kept.forEach((e, k) => {
            list.forEach(({ p, at }, i) => {
                if (p.id === e.s || p.id === e.t)
                    return;
                if (polylineNear(at.x, at.y, polys[k], p.r + 3))
                    wiresThroughDots++;
                if (polylineHitsBox(polys[k], boxes[i]))
                    wiresThroughLabels++;
            });
        });
        return { crossings, weightedCrossings, labelOverlaps, labelNodeOverlaps, wiresThroughDots, wiresThroughLabels };
    }
    const sortRow = (row, g) => row
        .map((p) => { var _a; return ({ p, t: targetX(p, g), prev: (_a = previousX.get(p.id)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : Infinity }); })
        .sort((a, b) => a.p.side - b.p.side || a.t - b.t || a.prev - b.prev || a.p.rank - b.p.rank || a.p.id - b.p.id)
        .map((o) => o.p);
    let orders = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows.length; r++)
        orders.push(sortRow(rows[r], placeOrders(orders)));
    let best = geometry(orders);
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 6; pass++) {
        let improved = false;
        for (let r = 0; r < orders.length; r++) {
            const all = best.pos;
            const resorted = sortRow(orders[r], all);
            if (resorted.some((p, i) => p !== orders[r][i])) {
                const trial = orders.slice();
                trial[r] = resorted;
                const t = geometry(trial);
                if (t.score < best.score - 1e-9) {
                    orders = trial;
                    best = t;
                    improved = true;
                }
            }
        }
        for (let r = 0; r < orders.length; r++) {
            for (let i = 0; i + 1 < orders[r].length; i++) {
                const row = orders[r];
                if (row[i].side !== row[i + 1].side)
                    continue;
                const swapped = row.slice();
                swapped[i] = row[i + 1];
                swapped[i + 1] = row[i];
                const trial = orders.slice();
                trial[r] = swapped;
                const t = geometry(trial);
                if (t.score < best.score - 1e-9) {
                    orders = trial;
                    best = t;
                    improved = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!improved)
            break;
    }
    const shifts = orders.map(() => 0);
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        for (let r = 0; r < orders.length; r++) {
            const row = orders[r];
            const slot = row.reduce((sum, p) => sum + 2 * p.slotHalf, 0) / Math.max(1, row.length) + cfg.slotGap;
            for (const f of [-0.5, -0.25, 0.25, 0.5, -1, 1]) {
                const trialShifts = shifts.slice();
                trialShifts[r] = f * slot;
                const t = geometry(orders, trialShifts);
                if (t.score < best.score - 1e-9) {
                    best = t;
                    shifts[r] = f * slot;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let budget = cfg.contextEdgeBudget(drawnContext.length);
    for (const e of optionalWires) {
        if (budget <= 0)
            break;
        kept.push(e);
        const m = measure(best.pos);
        if (m.wiresThroughDots > best.metrics.wiresThroughDots || m.crossings - best.metrics.crossings > 1) {
            kept.pop();
            continue;
        }
        best = { pos: best.pos, score: best.score, metrics: m };
        budget--;
    }
    const bends = new Map();
    {
        const g = best.pos;
        let bottom = 0;
        for (const id of drawnIds) {
            const p = pnodes.get(id);
            const box = labelBoxOf(p, g.get(id));
            bottom = Math.max(bottom, g.get(id).y + p.r, box.y + box.h);
        }
        const plateBottom = Math.max(cfg.minHeight, bottom + cfg.bottomPad);
        const files = drawnIds.map((id) => ({ p: pnodes.get(id), at: g.get(id), box: labelBoxOf(pnodes.get(id), g.get(id)) }));
        let balloonZone = null;
        if (lead && cfg.balloon) {
            const cx = (g.get(A).x + g.get(B).x) / 2;
            const bx = Math.max(12, Math.min(W - cfg.balloon.w - 12, cx - cfg.balloon.w / 2));
            balloonZone = { x: bx - 4, y: cfg.balloon.y - 4, w: cfg.balloon.w + 8, h: cfg.balloon.h + 8 };
        }
        const ends = (e) => {
            const p1 = g.get(e.s), p2 = g.get(e.t);
            return [p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y];
        };
        const polyOf = (e, bend) => {
            const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = ends(e);
            return wirePolyline(x1, y1, x2, y2, bend);
        };
        const current = new Map();
        for (const e of kept)
            current.set(e.id, polyOf(e, 0));
        const cost = (e, bend, limit = Infinity) => {
            const poly = polyOf(e, bend);
            let c = Math.abs(bend) * CURVE_COST.perBend;
            for (const { p, at, box } of files) {
                if (p.id !== e.s && p.id !== e.t && polylineNear(at.x, at.y, poly, p.r + 4.5))
                    c += CURVE_COST.throughDot;
                if (polylineHitsBox(poly, box))
                    c += CURVE_COST.throughLabel;
            }
            if (poly.some(([x, y]) => x < 3 || x > W - 3 || y < 3 || y > plateBottom - 3))
                c += CURVE_COST.outsidePlate;
            if (lead && poly.some(([, y]) => y < cfg.focusY - 4))
                c += CURVE_COST.throughBalloon;
            if (balloonZone && polylineHitsBox(poly, balloonZone))
                c += CURVE_COST.throughBalloon;
            for (const f of kept) {
                if (c >= limit)
                    return c;
                if (f === e || f.s === e.s || f.s === e.t || f.t === e.s || f.t === e.t)
                    continue;
                c += CURVE_COST.crossing * polylineCrossings(poly, current.get(f.id));
            }
            return c;
        };
        const curvable = kept
            .filter((e) => e !== lead)
            .map((e) => {
            const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = ends(e);
            return { e, len: Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1) };
        })
            .sort((a, b) => b.len - a.len || a.e.id - b.e.id)
            .map((o) => o.e);
        for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            for (const e of curvable) {
                let bestBend = (_j = bends.get(e.id)) !== null && _j !== void 0 ? _j : 0;
                let bestCost = cost(e, bestBend);
                for (const b of BEND_OPTIONS) {
                    const c = cost(e, b, bestCost);
                    if (c < bestCost - 1e-9) {
                        bestCost = c;
                        bestBend = b;
                    }
                }
                if (bestBend)
                    bends.set(e.id, bestBend);
                else
                    bends.delete(e.id);
                current.set(e.id, polyOf(e, bestBend));
            }
        }
        best = { pos: best.pos, score: best.score, metrics: measure(best.pos, bends) };
    }
    const keptIds = new Set(kept.map((e) => e.id));
    const hiddenEdgeIndices = raw.filter((e) => !keptIds.has(e.id)).map((e) => e.id);
    const finalPos = best.pos;
    let contentBottom = 0;
    for (const id of drawnIds) {
        const p = pnodes.get(id);
        const at = finalPos.get(id);
        const box = labelBoxOf(p, at);
        contentBottom = Math.max(contentBottom, at.y + p.r, box.y + box.h);
    }
    const contentHeight = contentBottom + cfg.bottomPad;
    const height = Math.ceil(Math.max(cfg.minHeight, contentHeight));
    const shiftY = drawnIds.length > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((cfg.minHeight - contentHeight) / 2)) : 0;
    const nodesOut = drawnIds.map((id) => {
        const p = pnodes.get(id);
        const at = finalPos.get(id);
        const x = round1(at.x);
        const y = round1(at.y + shiftY);
        const box = labelBoxOf(p, { x, y });
        const isFocus = focusSet.has(id);
        return {
            nodeIndex: id,
            path: p.path,
            shortLabel: p.label,
            dir: p.dir,
            changes: p.changes,
            x,
            y,
            r: p.r,
            isFeaturedEndpoint: isFocus,
            group: p.group,
            label: {
                nodeIndex: id,
                text: p.label,
                fullPath: p.path,
                position: isFocus ? 'N' : 'S',
                x: round1(box.x),
                y: round1(box.y),
                w: box.w,
                h: box.h,
                anchorX: x,
                anchorY: round1(box.y + 13),
                textAlign: 'center',
            },
        };
    });
    const nodeOut = new Map(nodesOut.map((n) => [n.nodeIndex, n]));
    const edgesOut = kept
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
        .map((e) => {
        var _a;
        return ({
            edgeIndex: e.id,
            sourceNodeIndex: e.s,
            targetNodeIndex: e.t,
            x1: nodeOut.get(e.s).x,
            y1: nodeOut.get(e.s).y,
            x2: nodeOut.get(e.t).x,
            y2: nodeOut.get(e.t).y,
            relationship: e.rel,
            intervalLow: e.low,
            strokeWidth: round1(1.4 + e.low * 2.8),
            isFeatured: featured.has(e.id),
            isLeadEdge: e === lead,
            bend: (_a = bends.get(e.id)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0,
        });
    });
    const leadOut = (_k = edgesOut.find((e) => e.isLeadEdge)) !== null && _k !== void 0 ? _k : null;
    const balloonTarget = leadOut && cfg.balloon ? { x: round1((leadOut.x1 + leadOut.x2) / 2), y: round1((leadOut.y1 + leadOut.y2) / 2) } : null;
    const balloonBox = balloonTarget && cfg.balloon
        ? {
            x: round1(Math.max(12, Math.min(W - cfg.balloon.w - 12, balloonTarget.x - cfg.balloon.w / 2))),
            y: cfg.balloon.y + shiftY,
            w: cfg.balloon.w,
            h: cfg.balloon.h,
        }
        : null;
    const coords = [];
    for (const n of nodesOut)
        coords.push(n.x, n.y, n.r, n.label.x, n.label.y, n.label.w);
    for (const e of edgesOut)
        coords.push(e.x1, e.y1, e.x2, e.y2, e.strokeWidth, e.bend);
    if (!coords.every((v) => Number.isFinite(v)) || !Number.isFinite(height)) {
        return emptyLayout(W, cfg.minHeight, mode, compSeen.size);
    }
    return {
        width: W,
        height,
        mode,
        nodes: nodesOut,
        edges: edgesOut,
        leadEdge: leadOut,
        balloonTarget,
        balloonBox,
        fullComponentNodeCount: compSeen.size,
        truncatedToEgoCap: compSeen.size > ego.length,
        hiddenContextEdges: hiddenEdgeIndices.length,
        hiddenEdgeIndices,
        overflow: overflowContext.map((c) => {
            var _a;
            return ({
                nodeIndex: c.id,
                path: pathOf(c.id),
                shortLabel: truncateLabel((_a = labelById.get(c.id)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : pathOf(c.id), cfg.maxLabelUnits + 10),
                group: c.group,
            });
        }),
        disconnectedNodeIndices: disconnected,
        metrics: best.metrics,
    };
}
function emptyLayout(width, height, mode, componentSize) {
    return {
        width,
        height,
        mode,
        nodes: [],
        edges: [],
        leadEdge: null,
        balloonTarget: null,
        balloonBox: null,
        fullComponentNodeCount: componentSize,
        truncatedToEgoCap: false,
        hiddenContextEdges: 0,
        hiddenEdgeIndices: [],
        overflow: [],
        disconnectedNodeIndices: [],
        metrics: { crossings: 0, weightedCrossings: 0, labelOverlaps: 0, labelNodeOverlaps: 0, wiresThroughDots: 0, wiresThroughLabels: 0 },
    };
}
return exports;
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('ra-data').textContent);
  var KINDS = {
    ghost: { label: 'Ghost wires' },
    unknown: { label: 'Unchecked' },
    indirect: { label: 'Indirect imports' },
    direct: { label: 'Import links' },
    test: { label: 'Test links' }
  };
  var ORDER = ['ghost', 'unknown', 'indirect', 'direct', 'test'];

  function sanitizeText(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(
      /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\u061c\u200b-\u200f\u2028-\u202e\u2060\u2066-\u2069\ufeff]/g,
      function (ch) {
        if (ch === '\n') return '\\n';
        if (ch === '\r') return '\\r';
        if (ch === '\t') return '\\t';
        var code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
        return code <= 255
          ? '\\x' + ('00' + code.toString(16)).slice(-2)
          : '\\u' + ('0000' + code.toString(16)).slice(-4);
      }
    );
  }

  function middleTruncate(str, maxLen) {
    var clean = sanitizeText(str);
    if (clean.length <= maxLen) return clean;
    var keep = Math.max(4, maxLen - 1);
    var head = Math.ceil(keep / 2);
    var tail = Math.floor(keep / 2);
    return clean.slice(0, head) + '\u2026' + clean.slice(clean.length - tail);
  }

  function hasKindInData(kind) {
    if (data.edges.some(function (e) { return e.relationship === kind; })) return true;
    return (data.families || []).some(function (f) {
      return (f.undrawnPairs || []).some(function (up) { return up.relationship === kind; });
    });
  }
  var hasPrimary = data.edges.some(function (e) { return e.relationship !== 'unknown'; });
  var visible = {
    ghost: hasKindInData('ghost'),
    unknown: !hasPrimary && hasKindInData('unknown'),
    indirect: hasKindInData('indirect'),
    direct: hasKindInData('direct'),
    test: hasKindInData('test')
  };

  var motionMedia = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') : null;
  var darkMedia = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') : null;
  var contrastMedia = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-contrast: more)') : null;
  var forcedColorsMedia = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(forced-colors: active)') : null;
  var reduceMotion = Boolean(motionMedia && motionMedia.matches);
  var highContrast = Boolean(contrastMedia && contrastMedia.matches);
  var forcedColors = Boolean(forcedColorsMedia && forcedColorsMedia.matches);

  var themeMode = 'system';
  try {
    var savedTheme = window.localStorage ? window.localStorage.getItem('ra-theme') : null;
    if (savedTheme === 'light' || savedTheme === 'dark' || savedTheme === 'system') {
      themeMode = savedTheme;
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  var themeToggleBtn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  var dirColorBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-dir-color');
  var fcProbe = document.getElementById('fc-probe');
  var colorByDir = false;
  var themeColors = null;

  function effectiveTheme() {
    if (themeMode === 'light' || themeMode === 'dark') return themeMode;
    return darkMedia && darkMedia.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }

  function invalidateThemeColors() {
    themeColors = null;
  }

  function applyThemeMode(mode, persist) {
    themeMode = mode;
    var root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute('data-theme-mode', mode);
    if (mode === 'light' || mode === 'dark') {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', mode);
    } else {
      root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    }
    if (themeToggleBtn) {
      var label = mode === 'system' ? 'Theme: System' : (mode === 'light' ? 'Theme: Light' : 'Theme: Dark');
      themeToggleBtn.textContent = label;
      themeToggleBtn.setAttribute('data-theme-mode', mode);
    }
    if (persist) {
      try {
        if (window.localStorage) window.localStorage.setItem('ra-theme', mode);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    invalidateThemeColors();
  }
  applyThemeMode(themeMode, false);

  function getThemeColors() {
    if (themeColors) return themeColors;
    var style = window.getComputedStyle ? window.getComputedStyle(document.documentElement) : null;
    function readVar(name, fallback) {
      if (!style) return fallback;
      var v = style.getPropertyValue(name);
      return v && v.trim() ? v.trim() : fallback;
    }
    var isDark = effectiveTheme() === 'dark';
    var colors = {
      desk: readVar('--f-desk', isDark ? '#000000' : '#e2e3e5'),
      sheet: readVar('--f-sheet', isDark ? '#050505' : '#ffffff'),
      panel: readVar('--f-panel', isDark ? '#19191a' : '#ffffff'),
      ink: readVar('--f-ink', isDark ? '#f1f0ea' : '#121212'),
      ink2: readVar('--f-ink-2', isDark ? '#b9b8b1' : '#4b4b4b'),
      rule: readVar('--f-rule', isDark ? '#f1f0ea' : '#121212'),
      grid: readVar('--f-grid', isDark ? '#2c2c2d' : '#e3e3e3'),
      marker: readVar('--f-marker', '#ffd60a'),
      markerInk: readVar('--f-marker-ink', '#121212'),
      fontDisplay: readVar('--f-font-display', '"Arial Black", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif'),
      fontMono: readVar('--f-font-mono', 'ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace')
    };
    if (highContrast) {
      colors.ink2 = colors.ink;
    }
    if (forcedColors && fcProbe && window.getComputedStyle) {
      var probeStyle = window.getComputedStyle(fcProbe);
      var fg = probeStyle.color && probeStyle.color.trim() ? probeStyle.color.trim() : colors.ink;
      var bg = probeStyle.backgroundColor && probeStyle.backgroundColor.trim() ? probeStyle.backgroundColor.trim() : colors.sheet;
      var hi = probeStyle.borderColor && probeStyle.borderColor.trim() ? probeStyle.borderColor.trim() : colors.marker;
      colors.sheet = bg;
      colors.panel = bg;
      colors.ink = fg;
      colors.ink2 = fg;
      colors.rule = fg;
      colors.marker = hi;
    }
    themeColors = colors;
    return colors;
  }

  var canvas = document.getElementById('map');
  var printImg = document.getElementById('print-map-img');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
  var panel = document.getElementById('panel');
  var search = document.getElementById('search');
  var resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset-view');
  var hintEl = typeof document.querySelector === 'function' ? document.querySelector('.hint') : null;
  function updateTouchHint() {
    if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = 'Two fingers to pan and zoom';
  }
  if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) {
    updateTouchHint();
  }

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }
  function pct(x) { return Math.floor(x * 100 + 1e-9) + '%'; }
  // Contributor concentration without naming the person: map reports are meant to be shared
  function contributorShareNote(author, share) {
    return author && typeof share === 'number' && share >= 0.4 ? ' · One contributor: ' + pct(share) + ' of commits' : '';
  }
  function formatCi(iv, raw) {
    return '(' + (raw ? 'raw ' : '') + '95% CI ' + Math.floor(iv.low * 100 + 1e-9) + '\u2013' + Math.ceil(iv.high * 100 - 1e-9) + '%)';
  }
  function base(p) { var i = p.lastIndexOf('/'); return i < 0 ? p : p.slice(i + 1); }
  function distinguishingPaths(a, b) {
    var aParts = a.split('/'), bParts = b.split('/');
    for (var depth = 1; depth <= Math.max(aParts.length, bParts.length); depth++) {
      var aLabel = aParts.slice(-depth).join('/');
      var bLabel = bParts.slice(-depth).join('/');
      if (aLabel !== bLabel) return [aLabel, bLabel];
    }
    return [a, b];
  }
  function plural(n, w) { return n.toLocaleString('en-US') + ' ' + w + (n === 1 ? '' : 's'); }
  function relativeDate(date) {
    var days = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.parse(data.generatedAt) - Date.parse(date)) / 86400000));
    if (days < 1) return '<ago>';
    if (days === 1) return '<ago>';
    if (days < 45) return days + ' days ago';
    var months = Math.round(days / 30.44);
    if (months < 18) return months + ' ' + (months === 1 ? 'month' : 'months') + ' ago';
    var years = (days / 365.25).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '');
    return years + ' years ago';
  }
  function capitalize(text) { return text.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + text.slice(1); }

  function hashHue(str) {
    var h = 2166136261;
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
      h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
    }
    return Math.abs(h) % 360;
  }
  function directoryColor(dir) {
    var hue = hashHue(dir || '.');
    var lightness = effectiveTheme() === 'dark' ? 68 : 32;
    return 'hsl(' + hue + ', 52%, ' + lightness + '%)';
  }

  function createSwatchSvg(kind) {
    var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    var svg = document.createElementNS(ns, 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('class', 'swatch-svg swatch ' + kind);
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 26 10');
    svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    var line = document.createElementNS(ns, 'line');
    line.setAttribute('x1', '1');
    line.setAttribute('y1', '5');
    line.setAttribute('x2', '25');
    line.setAttribute('y2', '5');
    if (kind === 'ghost') {
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--f-ink)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2.5');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '8 5');
    } else if (kind === 'direct') {
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--f-ink)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2.2');
    } else if (kind === 'indirect') {
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--f-ink-2)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.6');
    } else if (kind === 'unknown') {
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--f-ink-2)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '1.5 4');
    } else {
      line.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--f-ink-2)');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.2');
    }
    svg.appendChild(line);
    return svg;
  }

  var nodes = data.nodes.map(function (n, i) {
    return {
      i: i,
      path: n.path,
      safePath: sanitizeText(n.path),
      dir: n.dir,
      safeDir: sanitizeText(n.dir),
      changes: n.changes,
      author: n.topAuthor ? sanitizeText(n.topAuthor) : undefined,
      share: n.topAuthorShare,
      r: 4 + Math.min(14, Math.sqrt(n.changes) * 1.25),
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      active: true,
      frame: null,
      edges: []
    };
  });
  var edges = data.edges.map(function (e, idx) {
    var low = e.interval && typeof e.interval.low === 'number' ? e.interval.low : 0;
    var revLow = e.reverseInterval && typeof e.reverseInterval.low === 'number' ? e.reverseInterval.low : 0;
    var isWeak = (e.relationship === 'ghost' || e.relationship === 'unknown') && low < 0.3;
    var edge = {
      idx: idx,
      s: nodes[e.source],
      t: nodes[e.target],
      d: e,
      lowBound: Math.max(low, revLow),
      weak: isWeak,
      frame: null
    };
    edge.s.edges.push(edge);
    edge.t.edges.push(edge);
    return edge;
  });

  function edgeKey(a, b) {
    return a < b ? a + '\0' + b : b + '\0' + a;
  }
  var nodeByPath = Object.create(null);
  nodes.forEach(function (n) { nodeByPath[n.path] = n; });
  var edgeByPairKey = Object.create(null);
  edges.forEach(function (e) { edgeByPairKey[edgeKey(e.s.path, e.t.path)] = e; });

  var families = (data.families || []).map(function (f) {
    var famEdges = [];
    (f.edgeIndices || []).forEach(function (idx) {
      if (edges[idx]) famEdges.push(edges[idx]);
    });
    var relList = f.relationships || f.pairs;
    if (famEdges.length === 0 && relList) {
      relList.forEach(function (p) {
        var found = edgeByPairKey[edgeKey(p.from, p.to)];
        if (found) famEdges.push(found);
      });
    }
    var famNodes = [];
    (f.members || []).forEach(function (m) {
      var n = typeof m.nodeIndex === 'number' && nodes[m.nodeIndex] ? nodes[m.nodeIndex] : nodeByPath[m.path];
      if (n) famNodes.push(n);
    });
    return { d: f, members: f.members || [], edges: famEdges, undrawnPairs: f.undrawnPairs || [], nodes: famNodes };
  });

  var baseCounts = Object.create(null);
  nodes.forEach(function (n) {
    var b = base(n.safePath);
    baseCounts[b] = (baseCounts[b] || 0) + 1;
  });
  function getNodeLabel(n) {
    var b = base(n.safePath);
    if (baseCounts[b] <= 1) return middleTruncate(b, 26);
    var parts = n.safePath.split('/');
    if (parts.length >= 2) return middleTruncate(parts.slice(-2).join('/'), 26);
    return middleTruncate(n.safePath, 26);
  }

  var layoutEl = document.getElementById('ra-layout');
  var precomputed = null;
  if (layoutEl && layoutEl.textContent) {
    try { precomputed = JSON.parse(layoutEl.textContent); } catch (_) { precomputed = null; }
  }
  var frames = [];
  if (
    precomputed &&
    Array.isArray(precomputed.x) &&
    Array.isArray(precomputed.y) &&
    precomputed.x.length === nodes.length &&
    precomputed.y.length === nodes.length &&
    precomputed.x.every(function (v) { return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v); }) &&
    precomputed.y.every(function (v) { return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v); })
  ) {
    for (var li = 0; li < nodes.length; li++) {
      nodes[li].x = precomputed.x[li];
      nodes[li].y = precomputed.y[li];
    }
    if (Array.isArray(precomputed.frames)) {
      frames = precomputed.frames.map(function (f) {
        var fNodes = (f.nodeIndices || []).map(function (ni) { return nodes[ni]; }).filter(Boolean);
        var fEdges = (f.edgeIndices || []).map(function (ei) { return edges[ei]; }).filter(Boolean);
        var frameObj = {
          id: sanitizeText(f.id),
          index: f.index,
          band: f.band,
          caption: sanitizeText(f.caption),
          directionalSummary: f.directionalSummary ? sanitizeText(f.directionalSummary) : '',
          leadFile: f.leadFile ? sanitizeText(f.leadFile) : '',
          bridgedSubgroups: typeof f.bridgedSubgroups === 'number' ? f.bridgedSubgroups : 0,
          weak: Boolean(f.weak),
          cols: f.cols,
          row: f.row,
          x: f.x,
          y: f.y,
          w: f.w,
          h: f.h,
          pad: f.pad,
          nodes: fNodes,
          edges: fEdges,
          leadEdge: typeof f.leadEdgeIndex === 'number' && edges[f.leadEdgeIndex] ? edges[f.leadEdgeIndex] : (fEdges[0] || null)
        };
        fNodes.forEach(function (n) { n.frame = frameObj; });
        fEdges.forEach(function (e) { e.frame = frameObj; });
        return frameObj;
      });
    }
  }

  var m = data.meta;
  var span = m.oldestCommit && m.newestCommit ? ' between ' + m.oldestCommit + ' and ' + m.newestCommit : '';
  var KIND_NOUNS = { ghost: 'ghost wire', unknown: 'unchecked link', indirect: 'indirect import', direct: 'import link', test: 'test link' };
  // "3 unchecked links and 1 import link" for the relationships in a list that the filter bar hides
  function describeHidden(list) {
    var parts = [];
    ORDER.forEach(function (kind) {
      if (visible[kind]) return;
      var c = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].d.relationship === kind) c++;
      if (c > 0) parts.push(plural(c, KIND_NOUNS[kind]));
    });
    if (parts.length <= 1) return parts.join('');
    return parts.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' and ' + parts[parts.length - 1];
  }
  function updateSummary() {
    var shown = edges.filter(function (e) { return visible[e.d.relationship]; }).length;
    var hiddenText = describeHidden(edges);
    document.getElementById('summary').textContent =
      'Analyzed ' + plural(m.commitsAnalyzed, 'commit') + span + '. Loaded ' + plural(edges.length, 'relationship') +
      ' across ' + plural(frames.length, 'cut frame') +
      ' (each at least ' + m.settings.minShared + ' shared commits and ' + pct(m.settings.minConfidence) + ' confidence). ' +
      (hiddenText
        ? 'Showing ' + shown.toLocaleString('en-US') + '; the filter bar hides ' + hiddenText + '.'
        : 'Showing all ' + shown.toLocaleString('en-US') + '.');
  }
  updateSummary();

  var activeNodesList = [];
  var edgesByKind = { test: [], direct: [], indirect: [], unknown: [], ghost: [] };
  edges.forEach(function (e) {
    if (edgesByKind[e.d.relationship]) edgesByKind[e.d.relationship].push(e);
  });
  // Bumped whenever filters change or a file is dragged, so cached folder groups are rebuilt
  var layoutEpoch = 0;
  function syncActiveNodes() {
    activeNodesList = [];
    layoutEpoch++;
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var n = nodes[i];
      var deg = 0;
      var best = 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < n.edges.length; k++) {
        var ne = n.edges[k];
        if (!visible[ne.d.relationship]) continue;
        deg++;
        var w = (ne.d.overviewPriority || 0) * 100 + (ne.d.relationship === 'ghost' ? 50 : 0) + ne.lowBound * 10 + Math.min(50, ne.d.shared || 0) * 0.1;
        if (w > best) best = w;
      }
      n.active = deg > 0;
      // Which labels to keep when there is not room for all of them: strongest relationship, then degree
      n.importance = best + deg;
      if (n.active) activeNodesList.push(n);
    }
  }
  syncActiveNodes();

  var selectedNode = null, selectedEdge = null, selectedFamily = null, hoverNode = null, hoverEdge = null, hoverFamily = null, matches = null;
  var returnToFamily = null, expandedFamilyPairKey = null;
  var overviewTab = 'ghost';
  var overviewExpanded = false;
  var animPaused = false;

  function isVisible(e) { return Boolean(visible[e.d.relationship]); }
  function isActive(n) { return Boolean(n.active); }

  var toggles = document.getElementById('toggles');
  function ensureRelationshipVisible(rel) {
    if (!rel || visible[rel]) return;
    visible[rel] = true;
    if (toggles) {
      var btns = toggles.querySelectorAll('.toggle[data-kind]');
      for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
        if (btns[i].getAttribute('data-kind') === rel) {
          btns[i].classList.remove('off');
          btns[i].setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        }
      }
    }
    syncActiveNodes();
    updateSummary();
  }
  ORDER.forEach(function (kind) {
    var shown = edges.filter(function (e) { return e.d.relationship === kind; }).length;
    if (shown === 0 && !hasKindInData(kind)) return;
    var b = el('button', 'toggle' + (visible[kind] ? '' : ' off'));
    b.type = 'button';
    b.setAttribute('data-kind', kind);
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible[kind]));
    if (kind === 'unknown') b.title = 'Hidden by default when other links exist: import status could not be verified';
    b.appendChild(createSwatchSvg(kind));
    b.appendChild(el('span', '', KINDS[kind].label));
    b.appendChild(el('span', 'count', String(shown)));
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      visible[kind] = !visible[kind];
      b.classList.toggle('off', !visible[kind]);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible[kind]));
      syncActiveNodes();
      if (selectedEdge && !visible[selectedEdge.d.relationship]) selectedEdge = null;
      if (selectedFamily && !resolveActiveFamilyView(selectedFamily)) selectedFamily = null;
      if (returnToFamily && !resolveActiveFamilyView(returnToFamily)) returnToFamily = null;
      updateSummary();
      renderPanel();
      requestDraw();
    });
    toggles.appendChild(b);
  });

  if (themeToggleBtn) {
    themeToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var next = themeMode === 'system' ? 'light' : (themeMode === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'system');
      applyThemeMode(next, true);
      if (colorByDir) renderPanel();
      requestDraw();
    });
  }
  if (dirColorBtn) {
    dirColorBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      colorByDir = !colorByDir;
      dirColorBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(colorByDir));
      renderPanel();
      requestDraw();
    });
  }

  // ---- camera --------------------------------------------------------------
  var cam = { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 };
  var size = { w: 0, h: 0, dpr: 1 };
  function resizeNow() {
    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    var rw = rect.width > 0 ? rect.width : (canvas.clientWidth || 800);
    var rh = rect.height > 0 ? rect.height : (canvas.clientHeight || 600);
    var maxScale = Math.sqrt(16000000 / Math.max(1, rw * rh));
    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, maxScale);
    size.dpr = dpr;
    size.w = rw; size.h = rh;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rw * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rh * dpr);
    requestDraw();
  }

  // Space the view buttons take at the top of the canvas (they wrap to two rows on narrow screens)
  var stageOverlay = typeof document.querySelector === 'function' ? document.querySelector('.stage-overlay') : null;
  function toolbarClearance() {
    var h = stageOverlay && stageOverlay.offsetHeight ? stageOverlay.offsetTop + stageOverlay.offsetHeight : 0;
    return Math.max(44, Math.min(140, h + 4));
  }
  function rectBounds(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, padPx) {
    var w = Math.max(1, size.w);
    var h = Math.max(1, size.h);
    var pad = padPx != null ? padPx : 64;
    var topClearance = toolbarClearance();
    var availH = Math.max(120, h - topClearance);
    var spanW = Math.max(1, maxX - minX + pad * 2);
    var spanH = Math.max(1, maxY - minY + pad * 2);
    var scale = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(2.0, Math.min(w / spanW, availH / spanH)));
    return {
      x: (minX + maxX) / 2,
      y: (minY + maxY) / 2 - (topClearance / 2) / scale,
      scale: scale
    };
  }

  // Below this scale frame contents are not readable, so "fit" shows the top rows at this scale instead
  var FIT_MIN_READABLE_SCALE = 0.32;
  var BASE_HINT = hintEl ? hintEl.textContent : '';
  var fitInfo = { shown: 0, total: 0 };
  function updateFitHint() {
    if (!hintEl) return;
    var base = (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) ? 'Two fingers to pan and zoom' : BASE_HINT;
    hintEl.textContent = fitInfo.shown < fitInfo.total
      ? 'Showing the first ' + fitInfo.shown + ' of ' + fitInfo.total + ' groups. Drag, or zoom out, to reach the rest.'
      : base;
  }
  function fitSheet() {
    fitInfo = { shown: frames.length, total: frames.length };
    if (frames.length > 0) {
      var minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
      frames.forEach(function (f) {
        if (f.x < minX) minX = f.x;
        if (f.y < minY) minY = f.y;
        if (f.x + f.w > maxX) maxX = f.x + f.w;
        if (f.y + f.h > maxY) maxY = f.y + f.h;
      });
      var b = rectBounds(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, 36);
      var widthScale = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(2.0, Math.max(1, size.w) / Math.max(1, maxX - minX + 72)));
      if (b.scale < FIT_MIN_READABLE_SCALE && widthScale > b.scale) {
        // Too many groups to read at once: fit the sheet's width and start from the top rows
        var s = Math.min(widthScale, FIT_MIN_READABLE_SCALE);
        cam.scale = s;
        cam.x = (minX + maxX) / 2;
        cam.y = minY + (Math.max(1, size.h) / 2 - toolbarClearance() - 36) / s;
        var bottom = cam.y + Math.max(1, size.h) / 2 / s;
        var shown = 0;
        frames.forEach(function (f) { if (f.y + f.h <= bottom) shown++; });
        fitInfo.shown = Math.max(1, shown);
      } else {
        cam.x = b.x; cam.y = b.y; cam.scale = b.scale;
      }
      updateFitHint();
      return;
    }
    if (activeNodesList.length > 0) {
      var nMinX = Infinity, nMinY = Infinity, nMaxX = -Infinity, nMaxY = -Infinity;
      activeNodesList.forEach(function (n) {
        nMinX = Math.min(nMinX, n.x - n.r); nMaxX = Math.max(nMaxX, n.x + n.r);
        nMinY = Math.min(nMinY, n.y - n.r); nMaxY = Math.max(nMaxY, n.y + n.r);
      });
      var nb = rectBounds(nMinX, nMinY, nMaxX, nMaxY, 80);
      cam.x = nb.x; cam.y = nb.y; cam.scale = nb.scale;
    }
  }

  // ---- overview level of detail: folder groups for big frames, explained empty frames --------------
  // A frame with at least this many files is drawn as folder groups until it has enough screen area
  // per file to be read (AGG_MIN_PX2_PER_FILE), or until something inside it is selected or searched.
  var AGG_MIN_NODES = 25;
  var AGG_MIN_PX2_PER_FILE = 4000;
  var AGG_MAX_GROUPS = 7;
  function frameVisibleEdgeCount(f) {
    var c = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < f.edges.length; i++) if (visible[f.edges[i].d.relationship]) c++;
    return c;
  }
  function isEmptyFrame(f) {
    return f.edges.length > 0 && frameVisibleEdgeCount(f) === 0;
  }
  function refreshAggFlags() {
    var focused = [];
    if (selectedNode && selectedNode.frame) focused.push(selectedNode.frame);
    if (selectedEdge && selectedEdge.frame) focused.push(selectedEdge.frame);
    if (selectedFamily && selectedFamily.nodes) {
      selectedFamily.nodes.forEach(function (n) { if (n.frame) focused.push(n.frame); });
    }
    if (matches) matches.forEach(function (n) { if (n.frame) focused.push(n.frame); });
    var k2 = cam.scale * cam.scale;
    for (var i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
      var f = frames[i];
      f.agg = f.nodes.length >= AGG_MIN_NODES && focused.indexOf(f) < 0 && !isEmptyFrame(f) &&
        (f.w * f.h * k2) / f.nodes.length < AGG_MIN_PX2_PER_FILE;
    }
  }
  function detailScaleFor(f) {
    return Math.sqrt((AGG_MIN_PX2_PER_FILE * f.nodes.length) / Math.max(1, f.w * f.h)) * 1.06;
  }
  // Folder groups for a frame: files grouped by the shallowest directory depth that separates them
  // into at least five groups, capped at AGG_MAX_GROUPS (the smallest merge into "other folders").
  // Groups are laid out left to right in the order of their files' average position, staggered over
  // up to three rows, so the picture is the same at every zoom and labels have room.
  function frameGroups(f) {
    if (f._groups && f._groupsEpoch === layoutEpoch) return f._groups;
    var active = f.nodes.filter(isActive);
    var segs = active.map(function (n) { return n.safeDir === '(root)' || n.safeDir === '.' ? [] : n.safeDir.split('/'); });
    var prefix = 0;
    if (segs.length > 0) {
      for (;;) {
        var seg = segs[0][prefix];
        if (seg === undefined || !segs.every(function (sg) { return sg[prefix] === seg; })) break;
        prefix++;
      }
    }
    var maxDepth = 1;
    segs.forEach(function (sg) { maxDepth = Math.max(maxDepth, sg.length - prefix); });
    var byKey = null;
    for (var depth = 1; depth <= maxDepth; depth++) {
      byKey = Object.create(null);
      for (var i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
        var key = segs[i].slice(0, prefix + depth).join('/') || '(root)';
        (byKey[key] || (byKey[key] = [])).push(active[i]);
      }
      if (Object.keys(byKey).length >= 5) break;
    }
    var list = Object.keys(byKey || {}).map(function (key) { return { key: key, members: byKey[key] }; });
    list.sort(function (a, b) { return b.members.length - a.members.length || (a.key < b.key ? -1 : 1); });
    if (list.length > AGG_MAX_GROUPS) {
      var rest = list.slice(AGG_MAX_GROUPS - 1);
      var merged = { key: plural(rest.length, 'other folder'), members: [], other: true };
      rest.forEach(function (g) { merged.members = merged.members.concat(g.members); });
      list = list.slice(0, AGG_MAX_GROUPS - 1).concat([merged]);
    }
    var groupOf = Object.create(null);
    list.forEach(function (g, gi) {
      var sx = 0;
      g.members.forEach(function (n) { sx += n.x; groupOf[n.i] = gi; });
      g.frame = f;
